[[Parfum Palace]] }} '''Overthrowing a Tyrunt''' (Japanese: '''チゴラス、砕く''' ''{{tt|Chigoras|Tyrunt}}, Break'') is the 566th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 18th chapter of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} With [[Clemont]] using his Aipom Arm to search for the [[Mega Stone]] in a tree, the {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}} already hiding inside tries his best to avoid Clemont's camera, only to be caught while he muses about his journey to join [[Team Flare]]. {{adv|Shauna}} yells that the grunt is a villain, prompting Clemont to use his Aipom Arm to attack the grunt, sending him and his {{p|Tyrunt}} to fall out. No longer needing to hide, the grunt has his Tyrunt tear up the tree with its powerful jaw, sending it crashing down on the group of friends before Clemont can grab the Mega Stone. Despite Clemont managing to retrieve the Stone, the grunt pins him under the trunk and steals it from him anyway. The grunt sends out a group of four {{p|Espurr}} to attack the group, keeping {{adv|X}} and {{adv|Y}} at bay with their {{t|Psychic}} powers. Y tells X to give chase to the grunt, so X asks {{p|Manectric}} and {{adv|Trevor}} to follow him while the others keep the Espurr occupied. As she uses her {{p|Rhyhorn}} to rescue Clemont, Clemont reveals that he saw {{kal|Grace}} the previous day, much to Y's surprise. X, Trevor and Manectric chase the fleeing Tyrunt to [[Parfum Palace]], losing it in the hedge maze. Before X and Trevor can deliberate whether they should risk entering, Manectric leaps into the maze, forcing them to follow. As the boys, Manectric, [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga]] search, X realizes that Tyrunt isn't just running away, it's leading them around the maze for some reason. His fears are proven right as Tyrunt dives into Kanga's pouch, stealing Li'l Kanga's Mega Stone. Meanwhile, Y demands answers from Clemont, who recalls that Grace was also taken away by a group of Team Flare Grunts. The commotion from X's chase draws the attention of [[Cassius]], who has been using Parfum Palace as a base of operations and looks up from a videocall with {{adv|Bill}}, much to the latter's annoyance. Cassius tells Bill not to worry since he's been running the [[Kalos]] [[Pokémon Storage System]] for years without issue, gently poking fun at Bill's [[Goldenrod City|Goldenrod]] accent before ending the call. He tells his gang of punk girls that he's decided to investigate the ruckus going on outside. With Kanga and Li'l Kanga's Mega Stone stolen, Trevor is at a loss of what to do next. The Team Flare Grunt gloats at having successfully retrieved two Mega Stones, referring to them with their proper names: [[Kangaskhanite]] and [[Manectite]]. Seeing the boys confused, the grunt decides to tell them that every Pokémon capable of [[Mega Evolution]] has a specific matching Mega Stone, taunting them that despite having two of such Pokémon, they no longer have the Mega Stones to use. To Trevor's surprise, X encourages Trevor by saying that they've now obtained more information on Mega Evolution, and asks Manectric if that was why it [[PS63|followed them]] all the way from the [[Lumiose Gym]] after seeing Kanga and Li'l Kanga Mega Evolve. X asks Manectric if it wants to be his Pokémon, which Manectric happily confirms. Giving Manectric the new [[nickname]] of [[Élec]], X rides it into battle. Seeing X's initiative, Trevor realizes that Pokémon who can Mega Evolve have an innate drive to seek out their corresponding Mega Stone. He also observes that X has had many hunches throughout their journey that were proven right, and guesses that years of hiding away in paranoia have combined with X's natural affinity for battle to heighten his senses and insights. Trevor is happy to see that X is finally coming out of his shell as X orders a {{m|Wild Charge}} from Élec. ==Major events== * [[Clemont]] helps search for the [[Mega Stone]] in the tree, only to find the {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}} watching them. * The Grunt is exposed, but has his {{p|Tyrunt}} chew the tree and knock it down to collapse onto Clemont. * Clemont is crushed by the tree and the Mega Stone is taken. * {{adv|X}} and {{adv|Trevor}} chase after the Grunt while {{adv|Y}}, {{adv|Tierno}}, and {{adv|Shauna}} combat the Grunt's other Pokémon. * Clemont tells Y that her {{kal|Grace|mother}} has been captured by [[Team Flare]]. * X and Trevor arrive at the [[Parfum Palace]], where the Grunt also steals Kanga's Kangaskhanite. * X decides to keep {{p|Manectric}} and names it [[Élec]]. * [[Cassius]] overhears the commotion and decides to intervene. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== * [[Cassius]] ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|X}} * {{adv|Y}} * {{adv|Bill}} (video) * {{adv|Trevor}} * {{adv|Tierno}} * {{adv|Shauna}} * [[Clemont]] * [[Cassius]] * Cassius's gang * {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}} * Reporters (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Kangaskhan}} ([[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Kanga]];
